posts.name: Belteshazzar
posts.cooked: For me it depends on the phase of the game we're in. The first couple turns I like to give the support or high-setup heroes (Legacy/AA/Fixer/Wraith) the extra play, because usually getting the support going sooner helps the whole team. If we're not needing to project force, I'll try to set up my own board, like Ronway said, but later game I try to get the nukers playing as many cards as possible to maximize their output ("Why yes, I would like to play another Chain Lightning, thanks for asking!").
